nodes.name: When Called
nodes.notes: ADR-053 Block 4 — generate_image custom-tool handler. Called by the session loop (Stage B, Block 5) when the agent emits a generate_image custom_tool_use. Inputs: tool_input_json (the agent's tool input {prompt, reference_file_ids?, count?, aspect_ratio?, size?} as a JSON string); file_map_json (the session's {file_id->url} map from Upload Input Images (v1), Block 3: [{file_id,url,source_ref,mime,alt,order}]); impact (tier routing for the image batch); concurrency_cap; passthrough clickup_task_id/triggered_by/invocation_type/caller_user_id/process_type (for the batch's per-image cost rows). Test entry via scripts/test-subworkflow.mjs.

nodes.name: Get Anthropic Key
nodes.notes: Reads the anthropic_api_key Vault secret via SECURITY DEFINER getter public.get_anthropic_key() (migration 034) — needed ONLY for the Files-API upload of the generated images (image GENERATION uses LiteLLM's own image key inside the batch). Code nodes can't use n8n credentials and $env/$vars are unavailable on this CE (CLAUDE.md), so a credentialed Postgres read is how a workflow obtains the secret. Returns {key} (null if unseeded). A hard DB failure throws -> errorWorkflow CRITICAL (reactive layer).

nodes.name: Build Requests
nodes.notes: Parse the tool contract + session file map into the Generate Images Parallel (v1) requests_json seam (ADR-052 reference_urls[]). reference_file_ids -> reference_urls via the {file_id->url} map; an unresolved id is dropped with an image-tool/reference-not-found WARN (fail-soft: generate without that reference). count clamped 1..4 (count-clamped WARN). size/aspect_ratio map to the batch's size/aspect. Emits ONE item carrying key + requests_json + impact + passthrough + a do_generate gate (false when no key OR no prompt -> rides Should Generate? false to the sentinel). warnings are RETURNED (collected by Aggregate, fired by the caller/Block 5 via Post Alert), mirroring Upload Input Images -> Stage B; this keeps the sub-workflow's terminal branch-free (return-determinism trap, CLAUDE.md).

nodes.name: Should Generate?
nodes.notes: true -> call Generate Images Parallel. false (no key OR no prompt) -> Build Sentinel -> Merge (input 4) so the single terminal Aggregate always runs and returns a well-formed failed tool_result (with the no-prompt / key-unreachable WARN). main[1] is the IF false branch, not an error output.

nodes.name: Call Generate Images Parallel
nodes.notes: Calls Generate Images Parallel (v1) (2keb6XVWq5PG0leK) UNCHANGED — the ADR-052 reference_urls[] seam. One call passing requests_json (N requests); returns N items {placeholder_id, success, b64_json, used_reference, model, cost_pln, warnings[]...}. Per-image agent_runs cost rows are written by the batch's own Call Log Model Run (mode=each) — this handler adds NO second cost writer (master plan / ADR-053). onError:continueErrorOutput -> a batch THROW (e.g. LiteLLM image key missing, which the batch escalates CRITICAL via ITS OWN errorWorkflow) routes here to Build Batch Failed -> WARN + fail-soft, never re-thrown into the agent session.

nodes.name: Normalize Batch Output
nodes.notes: Re-emit each batch item as a clean self-paired item (so $('Normalize Batch Output').item resolves downstream after Convert to File + Upload replace $json — same paired-item idiom Upload Input Images uses with Split Out Images). Carries b64_json + per-image metadata + the batch's per-image warnings[] strings forward.

nodes.name: Is Success?
nodes.notes: true (image generated, b64 present) -> Convert to File -> Upload to Files API. false (generation failed/empty) -> Build Gen Dropped -> Merge (input 2) -> WARN + drop; the agent keeps reasoning (fail-soft). main[1] is the IF false branch.

nodes.name: Convert to File
nodes.notes: Move the batch's b64_json (base64 image) into a binary part `data` for the Files-API multipart upload. n8n's Code sandbox can't build multipart (form-data blocked) and the HTTP node's formBinaryData needs a binary property, so base64->binary goes through this node (CLAUDE.md). Runs once per generated image.

nodes.name: Upload to Files API
nodes.notes: POST /v1/files multipart (file part + purpose=agent) with anthropic-beta: files-api-2025-04-14 (Block 0 spec; copied from Upload Input Images (v1)). Key sourced via $('Build Requests').first().json.key (single-item upstream; Code nodes can't read the cred). Returns {id:file_..., filename, mime_type, size_bytes, downloadable:false} — the file_id the agent references to embed the generated image; the b64 is carried separately for delivery (uploaded files are not downloadable, Block 0). onError:continueErrorOutput -> upload failure (oversize 413, auth, network) -> Build Upload Dropped -> WARN + drop; never thrown into the session.

nodes.name: Build OK Entry
nodes.notes: Upload success -> map entry { ok:true, file_id, b64_json, mime, used_reference, placeholder_id, caption, alt, batch_warnings }. file_id is what the agent embeds; b64_json is carried for Block 6 delivery (uploaded files aren't downloadable). Metadata recovered via $('Normalize Batch Output').item; file_id from the upload response $json.id. alwaysOutputData so an empty branch still emits (Merge append never stalls — Read Input idiom).

nodes.name: Build Upload Dropped
nodes.notes: Upload failure -> dropped entry { ok:false, kind:'upload', placeholder_id, err, batch_warnings }. Aggregate turns it into a returned WARN; the image is omitted but the agent keeps reasoning. alwaysOutputData so the empty (no-failure) case still emits and Merge append never stalls.

nodes.name: Build Gen Dropped
nodes.notes: Generation failure (batch returned success:false / empty b64) -> dropped entry { ok:false, kind:'gen', placeholder_id, err, batch_warnings }. Aggregate turns it into a returned WARN; the agent keeps reasoning (fail-soft, ADR-051/052). $json here is the normalized batch item (Is Success? false branch passes it through). alwaysOutputData so the empty case still emits and Merge append never stalls.

parameters.jsCode:
const e = $json || {};
return { json: { ok: false, kind: 'gen', placeholder_id: e.placeholder_id || '', err: (e.error || 'generation_failed'), batch_warnings: Array.isArray(e.batch_warnings) ? e.batch_warnings : [] } };

nodes.name: Build Batch Failed
nodes.notes: Generate Images Parallel THREW (executeWorkflow error output). Emits a single { batch_failed:true, err } sentinel. Aggregate returns a WARN + a failed tool_result; the agent proceeds without an image. The underlying CRITICAL (e.g. LiteLLM image key missing) is already escalated by the BATCH's own errorWorkflow — this handler does NOT re-fire CRITICAL, just degrades fail-soft. alwaysOutputData so an empty (no-throw) error branch never stalls the Merge.

nodes.name: Build Sentinel
nodes.notes: No-work sentinel for the Should Generate? false branch (no key OR no prompt). Emits { no_work:true, no_prompt, key_missing } so the single terminal Aggregate still runs and returns a well-formed failed tool_result. alwaysOutputData so the branch never stalls the Merge append.

parameters.jsCode:
const b = ($input.first() && $input.first().json) || {};
return [{ json: { no_work: true, no_prompt: !!b.no_prompt, key_missing: !!b.key_missing } }];

nodes.name: Merge
nodes.notes: Converge OK (0), Upload Dropped (1), Gen Dropped (2), Batch Failed (3), and the no-work Sentinel (4) into ONE stream so Aggregate keeps a SINGLE input (a run-once-for-all-items node with N inputs runs once per connection and drops items — CLAUDE.md trap). Append = concat; tolerant of empty branches (alwaysOutputData upstream).

nodes.name: Aggregate
nodes.notes: SOLE TERMINAL (single input via Merge -> branch-free deterministic return, CLAUDE.md). Returns the tool_result the session loop (Block 5) hands the agent: { status, file_ids[], images[{file_id,b64_json,mime,used_reference,...}], warnings[], message, count_* , clickup_task_id }. file_ids are what the agent embeds; images carry b64 for Block 6 delivery (uploaded files aren't downloadable). warnings are RETURNED, fired by Block 5 via Post Alert (v1) (mirrors Upload Input Images -> Stage B); the batch's own per-image cost rows + any throw-CRITICAL are already handled inside the batch.

nodes.name: Has Carrier Bytes?
nodes.notes: ADR-053/055 Block 6: gate the delivery-bytes carrier. TRUE (file_id AND b64 present, a real generated image) -> persist the bytes to Supabase Storage so the output adapter can fetch them later (Files-API uploads are purpose=agent = NOT downloadable, and on the MCP path the bytes never return to n8n). FALSE (alwaysOutputData placeholder with no file_id/b64) -> straight to Merge[0] unchanged, as before.

nodes.name: Convert Carrier File
nodes.notes: ADR-053/055 Block 6: b64_json -> binary `data` for the Supabase Storage upload (the delivery-bytes carrier). Mirrors the Convert to File the Files-API upload already uses. onError=continueErrorOutput -> a decode failure routes to Build Carrier Dropped (fail-soft + delivery-risk WARN), never thrown into the session.

nodes.name: Upload Output Image to Storage
nodes.notes: ADR-053/055 Block 6: persist the produced image bytes to the private bucket agent-output-images at key=<Files-API file_id> via Supabase Storage REST (POST /storage/v1/object/{bucket}/{path}, x-upsert:true), so Render Agent Output (v1) can fetch them for ClickUp delivery (Files-API purpose=agent is not downloadable; on the MCP path bytes never return to n8n). Auth = predefined supabaseApi cred (service_role, bypasses RLS). Keyed by file_id (URL-safe). Bucket pruned on a 24h TTL (migration 037, mirrors the zip-inner purge). onError=continueErrorOutput -> Build Carrier Dropped: the image still embeds (it exists in the Files API) but a WARN flags that delivery may fail. cache-control short (objects are purged at 24h).

nodes.name: Build Stored OK
nodes.notes: ADR-053/055 Block 6: carrier write succeeded -> re-emit the original OK entry unchanged (file_id + b64_json + metadata) for Merge[5] -> Aggregate. The bytes are now in agent-output-images/<file_id>.

nodes.name: Build Carrier Dropped
nodes.notes: ADR-053/055 Block 6: carrier write (convert OR Storage upload) failed -> still emit the OK entry (the image exists in the Files API and the agent will embed its file_id) but mark carrier_failed so Aggregate fires an image-tool/carrier-write-failed WARN: the produced file_id may not be deliverable to ClickUp later (silent-degradation guard). alwaysOutputData so an empty branch never stalls the Merge append.
